espionage.name: Espionage
espionage.brief: Somebody quiet walks in, reads the filing cabinet, and walks out. Nothing is broken. That is the entire skill.

sabotage.name: Sabotage
sabotage.brief: Their centrifuge is going to have an unscheduled disagreement with physics. Get in, disagree, get out before anybody signs anything.

renewal.name: Unscheduled Urban Renewal
renewal.brief: The block was scheduled for demolition in nine years. We are ahead of schedule and the paperwork will catch up. Your specimen does not come home from this one.
